content.title: Are banks closed on Easter Monday? Is it a federal holiday? What's open, closed
content.text: April 6, 2026, 7:37 a.m. CTThe most sacred week on the Christian calendar is coming to an end now that Easter 2026 has passed.Easter Monday, the day after Christ's resurrection, is celebrated by Christians across the globe. It's even a public holiday in over 100 countries, including Canada, the UK and most of Europe.But if it's a holiday, will banks and stores be open? Stock markets? Will mail run?Here's what to know about Easter Monday, its federal holiday status, and more.When is Easter 2026?Easter is celebrated on Sunday, April 5, 2026.What is Easter Monday?Easter Monday celebrates the day after Jesus Christ's resurrection. According to History, several countries observe Easter Monday as a public holiday.In the third or fourth century, Christians began extending the Easter celebration, which originally ended on Easter Sunday, to eight days, per History.When is Easter Monday 2026? What date is Easter Monday this year?Easter Monday is on Monday, April 6, 2026.Is Easter Monday a federal holiday in the US?Easter Monday is a religious holiday, but it is not recognized as a federal holiday in the U.S.Will banks be open on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026? Are banks closed today?Most banks will be open on Easter Monday, according to The Federal Reserve.Is the stock market closed on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026? Is the stock market open today?The stock markets on New York Stock Exchange, Nasdaq and the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association are all open for trading on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026.Will mail run on Easter Monday? Is the post office open?Since Easter Monday is not a public holiday, there will be mail delivery and U.S. Postal Service post offices will be open Monday, April 6.Will FedEx be open today on Easter Monday, April 6, 2026?FedEx will be open on Easter Monday, April 6, but all other delivery options are expected to operate as normal.Will UPS be open today on Easter Monday, April 21, 2025?UPS Store is open and UPS delivery and pickup services are available on Easter Monday, April 21, 2025.Is Easter Monday a state holiday in Oklahoma?No. State employees are working all day on Easter Monday.When is Easter Day 2027? What date is Easter Sunday next year?In 2027, Easter Day will fall on Sunday, March 28.Contributing: Chris Sims
